$description: Mirror of app/globals.css (:root). The CSS file is the source of truth; if they differ, fix this file. 'proposed' entries are not in code yet.

bg.$description: Primary canvas background — deep OLED dark neutral

surface.$description: Standard panel and bento card surface

surface-raised.$description: Elevated card surface, popovers and modal containers

accent.$description: Apex Red — Primary interactive action, live session pulse

text-hi.$description: Headlines, driver names, numbers (19.8:1 on bg)

text-mid.$description: Secondary labels and meta (8.1:1 on bg)

text-low.$description: Captions and muted states (6.1:1 on bg)

telemetry-purple.$description: Fastest lap / fastest sector (proposed; used as raw hex in components today)

telemetry-green.$description: Personal best sector / position gain (proposed; used as raw hex in components today)

telemetry-yellow.$description: Caution / slow sector (proposed; used as raw hex in components today)

telemetry-red.$description: Red flag / hazard / DNF (proposed; used as raw hex in components today)

spring-standard.$description: Standard Apple spring physics for UI cards and modals (proposed; no shared constant in code yet)

spring-snappy.$description: Snappy micro-interactions for buttons and toggles (proposed; no shared constant in code yet)
